title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
읽기 / Read first: open 00_EGA_ko_CUMULATIVE_READER.pdf. This exact cumulative release covers EGA I front matter and introduction, all of EGA 0_I, the Chapter I programme and §§1–9, and §10 through all of §10.9; environment 10.10.1; Propositions 10.10.2, 10.10.3 and 10.10.5 with their proofs and intervening consequences; Corollary 10.10.6; environment 10.10.7; Proposition 10.10.8 and its proof; Corollary 10.10.9 and its proof; and §10.11 through Proposition 10.11.1 and its proof, environment 10.11.2, Theorem 10.11.3 and its proof, the immediately following equivalence statement, Corollaries 10.11.4 and 10.11.5 with their explanations, and environment 10.11.6. It ends immediately before Proposition 10.11.7 and does not claim that the full EGA corpus is complete.

This Korean edition remains in one Zenodo language lineage. A continuing Figshare article is retained as a possible additive preservation lineage; its next upload remains blocked by an inactive/disabled account, so no current Figshare r19 mirror is claimed. It is a translation of and part of the stable global/source EGA object at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20414353. The public repository is https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko. Editable TeX, exact source identities, decisions, corrections, build evidence, extraction checks, visual QA and SHA-256 manifests are included. Production contribution: AI typesetting & translation.

CC BY 4.0 applies only, to the extent rights are held, to the Korean translation, Korean typesetting, and project-authored metadata, indexes, decisions and QA evidence. The underlying mathematical work, historical French edition and third-party bibliographic material retain their own rights and attribution.
